responseText: Fresh through the portal from Sanctus? Good.Every new adventurer is another pair of eyes, another strong arm. Let your body anchor. The Essence is still flooding through you. I'd offer a pinch of "Portal Dust," but you're too old for such fancy.Welcome to the glorious halls of Mt. Dun: or what remains of its Dunzenkell glory.
